== Actual PC image chronology ==
The July 2018 Holotable import is an unmarked original Decipher scan, not a PC errata version. The first PC E face in this history dates to 27 September 2019 UTC; its D-E1 remake dates to 22 January 2023. Both retain the same PC game text. Existing current-page history moves to PC Errata2. Source faces spell the lore “Interrogator droid”; copied “Interceptor droid” was corrected against them. Earlier PC article has no new playable ID.
